# source_terminal_skip_hello_tarball

Pins the source-terminal short-circuit. Source terminals (the
arch-independent leaf roles `*.tar.gz.drv`, `*.tar.xz.drv`,
`*-source`, `*-fetchurl-*`, `*-builder.sh`, `*.patch`,
`*-setup-hook`) substitute from the binary cache; emitting a
``build_common_dep`` task for one would have the framework
trying to rebuild a tarball that's already fetchable.

The predicate ``_is_source_terminal_role`` (in
``template_graph/parser/role.py``) gates the alloc-time
short-circuit inside ``make_template_node`` /
``_alloc_singleton``; the counter ``out.source_terminal_skipped``
ticks once per fresh alloc that the predicate skipped.

**Tree**: 1 binary `hello` x 1 cell x 2 variants. Each variant's
``hello-2.12.drv`` child has two tarball children:
``hello-2.12.tar.gz.drv`` and ``gettext-runtime-0.21.1.tar.gz.drv``.
Each tarball has a single inner-child to confirm the short-
circuit DISCARDS the subtree (no inner-child appears as a
template node).

**Expected**:
  - ``build_variant_count == 2``.
  - ``source_terminal_skipped_min >= 2`` — the planner skipped
    the alloc for both tarballs (alloc-time predicate).
  - ``no_common_dep_for_terminals`` lists the two tarball
    names; the harness inspects each ``build_common_dep``
    descriptor's ident and asserts none contains these.

**variant_lookup.json convention**: list-of-records,
``[{"key": [arch, label], "value": {...}}, ...]``.

**tree.txt provenance**: generated by
``template_graph.tests.test_streaming.fixtures.render_tree``.
